faq.description: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about BabiesPicks.
faq.heroSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our reviews and platform.

whatIs.a: BabiesPicks is an independent Saudi platform for baby and maternity product reviews. We provide honest, data-driven verdicts to help mothers make better purchasing decisions for their children.

howWeReview.a: We review each product based on 5 criteria: Safety (25%), Quality (25%), Reviews (20%), Price (15%), and Long-term Value (15%). We use AI to analyze thousands of reviews from real Saudi mothers.

trustworthy.a: Yes! Our opinions are 100% independent. We don't receive payment from companies to improve their product ratings. We also clearly disclose any affiliate relationships. We follow the 14-day rule to track prices before issuing any verdict.

verdictSystem.q: How does the verdict system work?
verdictSystem.a: We give each product a score out of 10. Based on the score, the product is classified as: Worth It (8+), Worth It (Conditional) (6-8), Wait (4.5-6), or Not Worth It (below 4.5). The score is a weighted average of the 5 criteria.

scores.a: Each criterion is scored 1-10. The overall score is a weighted average: Safety 25%, Quality 25%, Reviews 20%, Price 15%, Long-term Value 15%. A score of 8+ means 'Worth It'.

commission.q: Do you earn commissions from links?
commission.a: Yes, some links on the site are affiliate links and we earn a small commission when you purchase through them. This never affects our opinions, ratings, or product rankings.

contactUs.a: You can reach us at hello@babiespicks.com or through the contact form on our Contact page. We usually respond within 24-48 hours.

contentUpdate.a: We update reviews periodically and when new products launch or major price changes occur. We track prices daily to ensure accuracy. Any update is reflected in the 'Last updated' date shown on each page.

english.q: Is the site available in English?
english.a: Yes! The site is available in Arabic (default) and English. You can switch between languages using the language toggle button at the top of the page.

prices.a: Prices are shown in Saudi Riyal (SAR). We strive to display the latest prices, but they may change. We update prices regularly and track them for at least 14 days before issuing any verdict.
